description: Labelled prompt pairs for choosing the semantic cache's similarity threshold (design note 36). expected 'hit': b means the same as a and the same answer is correct, so b may be served a's cached answer. expected 'no_hit': b looks like a but needs a different answer, so serving a's answer would be wrong. Each pair is a single-turn user message at temperature 0, with the same client, model and no system prompt.
status: REVIEWED by Claude on 2026-11-18 at the owner's request (the owner delegated the review). Three ambiguous paraphrases were reworded so they ask for the same answer; no labels were flipped.
